prompt: Create two orthographic plan projections of the same choice portal in a 2-cell atlas: left cell TOP viewed from directly above, right cell BOTTOM viewed from directly below. Use the actual choice-portal source as material/identity reference. Use the approved emergency-exit portal TOP/BOTTOM only as geometric guidance for a STRAIGHT BAR plan and flat square foot undersides; do not copy its materials. The portal opening is a vertical planar arch, so its curved front arch face collapses in plan: TOP must be a straight horizontal gold lintel-depth strip with two square/rectangular pillar-cap footprints and the shallow threshold, NOT a curved, oval, circular, U-shaped or arch-shaped outline. Blue energy face, diamonds, finials, and vertical banners are occluded and must not appear as face images. BOTTOM is the flat underside of the two square pillar feet and threshold span, no rounded finials, no oblique front faces, no portal energy or circular machinery. Preserve the choice portal’s gold/blue source palette, but show only horizontal surfaces from these cameras. Transparent empty backgrounds, centered isolated view per cell, no perspective, text, neighboring objects or extra floor.
